sentences.en: She learned the craft of basket weaving from her grandmother.
sentences.zh: 她从祖母那里学会了编织篮子的手艺。

sentences.en: The boxer weaved out the way to avoid getting hit.
sentences.zh: 拳击手巧妙地移动以避开攻击。

sentences.en: Have each of your wives weave a rug by tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 让每位妻子在明天之前织一块地毯。

phrases.zh: 雅尼的音乐风格独特，富有变化
